speaker: buyer
text: Hi Priya, thanks for making time. I have gone through your application and the SKU sheet. We like the creamy lick treats, but the numbers need work before we can place an order.

speaker: vendor
text: Thanks for having me. Happy to talk through it. What are you looking at first?

speaker: buyer
text: Margin. You offered 17 percent, and our treats target is 35 percent. Where can you get to?

speaker: vendor
text: Seventeen is thin, I know. Our tuna and salmon costs went up this year. If you take the full treats range, I can move to 21 percent.

speaker: buyer
text: Twenty-one is better but still short. Can you go to 24?

speaker: vendor
text: No, 21 is my floor on the treats. The litter I can look at again once we see sales, but not today.

speaker: buyer
text: Understood, 21 percent margin is recorded. Next, payment terms. Your application says 15 days. We need at least 21 days.

speaker: vendor
text: Fifteen is hard for us, we are a young company. But I can do 30 days if the order is confirmed in writing this week.

speaker: buyer
text: Agreed, 30 days payment terms, order confirmed in writing. Now minimum order quantity. You have 800 units, and our forecast is far lower for a new brand.

speaker: vendor
text: 800 is what our production batch needs. I can bring it down to 500 units in total for the first order, split across the SKUs you list.

speaker: buyer
text: Good, 500 units in total for the first order, split across the SKUs we list. What about launch marketing support? You listed 20,000 rupees.

speaker: vendor
text: We can raise that to 50,000 rupees for the launch month, to be used on sponsored listings and sampling.

speaker: buyer
text: Thank you. And a launch discount for the first month? Your application has none.

speaker: vendor
text: I can give a 5 percent launch discount for the first 30 days.

speaker: buyer
text: That works. One more request: sale-or-return on unsold stock after 90 days, since this is a new brand for us.

speaker: vendor
text: I am sorry, I cannot accept returns of unsold stock. Treats have a short shelf life and we cannot resell them. Defect returns within 7 days stay as they are.

speaker: buyer
text: Fine, no sale-or-return. To recap: 21 percent margin, 30 days payment, 500 units MOQ, 50,000 rupees marketing support, 5 percent launch discount for 30 days, defect returns within 7 days only.

speaker: vendor
text: That is correct. I will send the written confirmation by Friday.
